generation_prompt: The robot uses its right hand to grasp the Rubik's cube on the circular gray mat between its thumb and curled fingers, then lifts it clear. It carries the cube to the black rack on its right, lowers it among the produce, and opens its hand to release it inside the rack. Keep the camera fixed; preserve robot geometry, physically valid joint motion, and normal gripper opening and closing.
observed_terminal_state: Cube has left the circular mat and rests inside the black rack among the produce. Right hand is open above it with visible separation from the cube; left hand remains open and uninvolved.

arm_hand_roles.right: Active hand: grasps cube with thumb and fingers, lifts, transports to black rack, lowers, and releases it.
arm_hand_roles.left: Remains open beside the mat with slight passive changes in pose; does not contact the cube, rack, or right hand.
arm_hand_roles.coordination: Single-hand manipulation. No two-hand transfer or object stabilization; no interaction with a person.

uncertainties: Exact bottom-surface contact and final cube orientation are partially occluded by the right hand and produce; visible separation confirms release into the rack.

data_quality_gate.rule: Variance of the Laplacian of the luma of the model-view frame (cover-resize to the nearest-aspect 720p-class bucket, center crop); pass if >= 120 third-person, >= 60 first-person.
